in_sanskrit.name: एशिथन्श
in_sanskrit.meaning: अशित हरणम् (अशित = quick, harana = to seize)

in_marathi.name: Eshithansh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eshithansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eshithansh is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'Eshi' (God) and 'Thansh' (grace). It signifies the divine blessings and grace bestowed upon an individual.

in_bengali.name: Eshithansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God's grace
in_bengali.long_meaning: Eshithansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Eshithansh is derived from the Sanskrit roots 'Eshi' (God) and 'Thansh' (grace). It signifies the divine blessings and grace bestowed upon an individual.
